body:
nico: telemetry flagged missing aggregates for 2026-05-02 06:15-06:45 UTC. late delivery to legacy bucket. want a conservative recompute plan that avoids blowing Dedicated burst.

anya: which shards/tenants? can we split by tenant to keep peak low?

nico: tenants: omega-co and sigma-llc. shards 10,11. raw rows ~140k but expect heavy dedupe.

fred: plan: preflight -> warm cache -> dry-run -> sequential replay per tenant with a 10m gap. console should expose a "sequential per-tenant" toggle and show per-step token estimates + a required typed confirmation if any step > 60k.

leah: UX: also show an option to auto-warm KV cache and surface estimated token savings. include an "allow quota override" toggle but require on-call signoff.

router-bot: preflight requested by nico at 1819990012. cmd: /replay/preflight tenants=["omega-co","sigma-llc"] shards=[10,11] window=[2026-05-02T06:15Z..2026-05-02T06:45Z]

router-bot: preflight result: omega-co -> 72.8k tokens est, sigma-llc -> 48.4k tokens est, total=121.2k; est_duplicates=~11.1k; slot_seconds=900

anya: total high. sequential run makes sense. prefer warming omega-co cache first to reduce peak (~15%).

ops-bot: cache-warm started for omega-co.

ops-bot: cache-warm complete, est savings=14%. updated omega-co estimate=62.5k.

fred: dry-run omega now.

ops-bot: dry-run complete: duplicates_found=5,900; token_estimate=62.3k; schema_ok

nico: starting live omega replay with dedupe and quota-override 65k (on-call approved). will wait 12m before sigma. Command: /replay run --tenant omega-co --shards 10,11 --dedupe --quota-override 65k

ops-bot: live job started id=r-20260502-700 routing: dedicated-burst -> fallback standard

router-bot: mid-run note: small fallback (0.8%), router preserved X-Idempotency-Key and X-KV-Cache-Tag.

ops-bot: omega job finished: tokens_used=62,140; duplicates_removed=5,882; no SLO breaches.

fred: waiting 12m then running sigma. will warm cache first.

ops-bot: sigma cache-warm done. est savings=12%. updated sigma estimate=42.6k.

ops-bot: sigma live replay started with dedupe, no override.

ops-bot: sigma finished: tokens_used=42,410; duplicates_removed=5,230.

nico: totals: tokens_used ~104.5k after warms; duplicates ~11.1k. Good. Follow-ups: (1) console: add sequential per-tenant run + typed confirmation modal (leah), (2) add cache-warm example to runbook (fred), (3) router: ensure both idempotency and kv-cache headers preserved on fallback (router-bot).

leah: will mock the UI flows and include a stepper showing per-step estimates.

nico: closing thread, will file a short postmortem in #postmortems with numbers. :white_check_mark:
